scientific_integrity: Explicit paired-rail count, coefficient derivation, pointwise and aggregate statements, and reproducible finite verification; no assertion of publication or historical priority beyond inspected comparisons.
scientific_limitations: Results are for total weakly nonincreasing transformations of finite labeled chains, not partial or arbitrary transformations. Finite enumeration through n=9 is corroboration of an independent arbitrary-n proof. The univariate and joint image-rank formulas were previously published for the nondecreasing class and are not claimed independently new. Potential earlier general root-counting coverage remains a historical-priority risk. No independently performed scientific audit is asserted.
title: Order-reversing square roots of chain idempotents: paired-rail factorization and rank equidistribution
